aboutGame.title: What is Clone Builders?
paragraphs: Clone Builders is a free experimental building sandbox on Roblox from developer Synoptic Interactive. Instead of placing every part yourself, you hand a build idea to a crew of NPC clones and a structured building system places, resizes, moves, and assembles the parts into a finished creation.

The game is open about being experimental, and the developers state that builds are not AI-generated, so the clarity of your request decides the result. Between Clone Coins, badges, upgrades, private servers, and a 15-player shared building space, there is a steady stream of systems to learn, and this wiki maps all of them.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Clone Builders.

items.question: What is Clone Builders?
items.answer: Clone Builders is a free experimental building sandbox on Roblox from Synoptic Interactive. You hand an idea to a crew of NPC clones, and a structured building system places, resizes, moves, and assembles the parts for you.

items.question: How do clones decide what to build in Clone Builders?
items.answer: Clone Builders clones do not use AI. They follow a structured part system, so the clarity of your request decides the result: short, focused prompts land far better than long, complicated ones.

items.question: Are there working Clone Builders codes?
items.answer: No. As of September 2026, Clone Builders has not released a single redeemable code, so any list claiming working Clone Builders codes is outdated or fabricated. This wiki tracks the real status.

items.question: What should beginners build first in Clone Builders?
items.answer: Start with a compact, single-clone structure and keep travel paths short. Once that loop is stable, scale up to multi-part projects and larger clone crews in Clone Builders.

items.question: Can you build with friends in Clone Builders?
items.answer: Yes. Clone Builders supports shared building in servers of up to 15 players, and private servers let you and your partners build without interruptions.
